title: Runway introduces GWM Worlds 2 research preview
summary: Runway announces GWM Worlds 2, a generative AI model that creates continuous interactive audiovisual worlds. It functions as an autoregressive diffusion model generating 720p at 24fps with 48kHz audio in real-time, responding to user actions and allowing world modification during sessions. Positioned as a successor to GWM-1, it targets game development, virtual characters, and robotics.
